pages.title: Project Directory
pages.description: The folder on your host machine mounted as /workspace inside the container.
pages.hint: Both Windows (C:\path) and Unix (/path or C:/path) formats accepted.

pages.description: Share project memories with Claude Desktop?
pages.hint: Yes — projects/ and todos/ sync with your host Claude Desktop. No — fully isolated.

pages.description: Keys are stored only in your local .env — never sent anywhere.

fields.hint: Leave blank if you log in via claude.ai

pages.title: Git Identity
pages.description: Used for commits made inside the container.

pages.title: Dev Tools  (optional)
pages.description: Lazy-installed on first run into named volumes — instant on every start after.

pages.title: Plugins  (optional)
pages.description: Installed once, sentineled. Add/remove later: ./run.sh plugins add/remove <name>

pages.title: Custom Configs  (optional)
pages.description: Point to files on your host — mounted read-only into the container.
pages.hint: Leave blank to use built-in defaults.
